name: qa-postman-api-testing
description: Manual and API testing portfolio: test plan, Postman collection, Newman CI, bug reports for the Restful-Booker practice API and the SauceDemo practice shop.

scripts.test:api: newman run collections/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e environments/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder "01 Read bookings" --folder "02 Create and search" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api-regression-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful-Booker: regression checks"
scripts.test:defects: newman run collections/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e environments/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder "03 Input validation and formats (known defects)" --suppress-exit-code -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api-defects-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful-Booker: known defects"
scripts.test:auth: newman run collections/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e environments/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder "01 Read bookings" --folder "02 Create and search" --folder "04 Login and changes" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api-auth-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful-Booker: with login"
